business_profile.business_overview: JobaidaPack Packaging Ltd is a leading manufacturer of custom corrugated boxes and packaging materials in Bangladesh, operating since 1996. Their product range spans Regular Slotted Cartons (single/double/triple-wall for shipping and distribution), premium Mailer Boxes for e-commerce and branded unboxing, and ultra-premium Rigid Boxes for jewelry, cosmetics, and luxury branding. Notably, they already have a 'Get a Quote' page, a 'Track Order' feature, and reference a 'JobaidaPackERP' — evidence they've invested in digital tooling and are receptive to automation. Their sales line is 01568316131 with sales@jobaidapack.com. As a B2B manufacturer serving e-commerce brands and exporters, quote speed and order-status communication are their biggest service levers.

business_profile.competitive_position: JobaidaPack is an established, nearly 30-year-old manufacturer with a modern web presence and real digital investment (ERP, order tracking, quote page). That puts them ahead of most BD packaging suppliers operationally. The gap is the AI layer: instant quoting, automated status updates, and re-order nudges. Adding an agent would make them the most responsive packaging supplier in the market — a concrete differentiator for winning e-commerce and export accounts.
business_profile.opportunity_size: As a B2B manufacturer with repeat clients, quote turnaround directly drives order volume. If slow manual quoting loses even a few orders per month, and status-query handling consumes staff hours daily, an AI agent that delivers instant ballpark quotes, auto-answers 'where is my order', and prompts re-orders recovers revenue AND frees capacity. For a 30-year manufacturer, this is a retention + efficiency play worth lakhs per month.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI quote agent that captures specs (box type, size, quantity, print) from the 'Get a Quote' page or WhatsApp and returns an instant ballpark, routing serious B2B enquiries to sales.
2. Order-status agent that answers 'where is my order?' automatically 24/7, pulling from the existing Track Order / ERP data.
3. Re-order agent that tracks client order cycles and prompts repeat purchases before they run out.
4. Lead-qualification agent that scores inbound enquiries by volume and urgency so sales focuses on the biggest accounts.
business_profile.demo_scenario: An e-commerce brand needs 5,000 custom mailer boxes and fills JobaidaPack's 'Get a Quote' form at 8pm. In seconds the AI replies: 'For 5,000 full-color mailer boxes (300x220x80mm), ballpark is ৳X–Y depending on board grade. I've logged your specs — a sales rep will confirm exact pricing by 10am. Want me to also set up a re-order reminder for next quarter?' The brand says yes. JobaidaPack wakes up to a qualified, spec-complete order they'd otherwise have quoted a day late — and a locked-in repeat customer.
